job_description.overview: We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our growing analytics team. You will work on challenging projects involving customer behavior analysis, predictive modeling, and business intelligence solutions. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong programming skills looking to grow in the data science field.
responsibilities: Analyze large datasets to extract meaningful insights and patterns
Build and deploy machine learning models for predictive analytics
Create data visualizations and dashboards to communicate findings to stakeholders
Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements and translate them into data solutions
Perform statistical analysis and hypothesis testing
Clean, preprocess, and transform raw data for analysis
Develop and maintain data pipelines for automated reporting
Stay updated with the latest trends in data science and machine learning
Document methodologies and present findings to technical and non-technical audiences

soft_skills_required.description: Ability to break down complex problems and think logically
Explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders
Creative approach to solving business problems with data
Eager to learn new techniques and stay updated with industry trends
Ensure data accuracy and model reliability

education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or related field
Master's degree is a plus but not required
experience: 1-3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or related field
Experience with real-world data science projects (academic or professional)
Portfolio of data science projects on GitHub is highly valued
certifications_preferred: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate

benefits: Health insurance and annual health check-ups
Professional development budget for courses and conferences
Flexible working hours and hybrid work options
Modern office with latest tech equipment
Annual company trips and team-building activities
Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing company

application_process.how_to_apply: Send your CV, cover letter, and portfolio/GitHub link to careers@vintech-analytics.com
